Module.Name: Focal processing factors
Module.Description: Focal processing factors are multiplication factors to derive the concentration in a processed food from the concentration in an unprocessed food and can be specified for identified processing types (e.g., cooking, washing, drying). Focal processing factors are primarily used in dietary exposure assessments to correct for the effect of processing on substance concentrations in dietary exposure calculations.
Module.ShortDescription: Focal processing factors are multiplication factors to derive the concentration in a processed food from the concentration in an unprocessed food and can be specified for identified processing types (e.g., cooking, washing, drying).
Module.DataDescription: Specify for a combination of processing type, food and substance the focal processing factor (nominal, upper).
